headline: European Natural Gas Surges Above €86/MWh on Norwegian Outage and Cold Weather
summary: European natural gas futures rose past €86 per megawatt-hour due to reduced pipeline exports caused by an outage at Norway's Troll gas field. Unseasonably cold weather forecasts across Northwest Europe further heightened demand expectations.
why: The Dutch TTF natural gas contract serves as the continent-wide benchmark for wholesale gas pricing and heating energy costs in Europe.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: Norwegian offshore production outages combined with cold forecasts pushed European wholesale gas futures higher.
